passages.text: In the title compound, [Fe(C<sub>5</sub>H<sub>5</sub>)(C<sub>21</sub>H<sub>19</sub>N<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>)], both pyrrol idine rings of the pyrrolizine substructure show an envelope conformation. <sentence_start/>In the ferrocenyl moiety, the unsubstituted cyclo penta dienyl ring is disordered over two orientations with site occupancies of 0.64 (2) and 0.36 (2). <sentence_start/>In the pyrrolizine ring, one C atom is disordered over two positions, with site occupancies of 0.71 (1) and 0.29 (1). <sentence_start/>Intra molecular C-H⋯O inter actions occur. <sentence_start/>The crystal packing is established through weak inter molecular C-H⋯O and N-H⋯O inter actions.

For the biological activity of ferrocene derivatives, see: Fouda <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic> (2007<citation ref-type="bibr" rid="bb3" count="1"> ▶</citation>); Jaouen <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic> (2004<citation ref-type="bibr" rid="bb5" doi="10.2174/0929867043364487" pmid="15379709" count="1"> ▶</citation>); Biot <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic> (2004<citation ref-type="bibr" rid="bb1" count="1"> ▶</citation>). <sentence_start/>For related structures, see: Kamala <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic> (2009<citation ref-type="bibr" rid="bb6" doi="10.1107/S1600536809018583" pmcid="PMC2969822" pmid="21583045" count="1"> ▶</citation>); Gunasekaran <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic> (2009<citation ref-type="bibr" rid="bb4" doi="10.1107/S1600536809049629" pmcid="PMC2972181" pmid="21578681" count="1"> ▶</citation>);

Metallocenes exhibit antibacterial (Fouda <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic>, 2007), antitumor (Jaouen <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic>, 2004), antimalarial and antifungal (Biot <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic>, 2004) activities. <sentence_start/>The geometric parameters of the title compound (Fig. 1) agree well with reported similar structures (Kamala <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic>, 2009; Gunasekaran <italic toggle="yes">et al.</italic>, 2009). <sentence_start/>N9c atom adopts <italic toggle="yes">sp<sup>3</sup></italic> hybridization [sum of bond angles around N9c is 332.69 (2) °].

In the ferrocenyl moiety, one cyclopentadienyl (Cp) ring is disordered over two orientations [site occupancies of 0.64 (2) and 0.36 (2), respectively]. <sentence_start/>In the pyrrolizine ring one C atom is disordered over two positions [site occupancies of C12 and C12A are 0.71 (1) and 0.29 (1), respectively]. <sentence_start/>Crystal packing is established through weak intermolecular C-H···O and N-H···O interactions.

A mixture of methyl-2-hydroxy ferrocenyl methyl acrylate (1 mmol), isatin (1 mmol) and proline (1 mmol) was refluxed in methanol for 12 h until completion of the reaction was evidenced by TLC analysis. <sentence_start/>After completion of the reaction the solvent was evaporated under reduced pressure. <sentence_start/>The crude mixture was purified by column chromatography using ethyl acetate and hexane as eluent (10: 90). <sentence_start/>The product was dissolved in a methanol/chloroform mixture and heated for two minutes. <sentence_start/>The resulting solution was subjected to crystallization by slow evaporation of the solvents for 48 hours resulting in the formation of single crystals (yield 65%).

Site occupancy factors of disordered C atoms in the Cp ring were refined as 0.64 (C19-C23) and 0.36 (C19A-C23A). <sentence_start/>Disorder in the pyrrolizine system was refined to sof's of C12 = 0.71 (1) and C12A = 0.29 (1). <sentence_start/>Carbon-carbon bond distances in the disordered Cp ligand (C19A-C23A) were restrained to 1.450 (1) Å. <sentence_start/>H atoms were positioned geometrically and refined using riding model with C-H = 0.93 Å and <italic toggle="yes">U</italic><sub>iso</sub>(H) = 1.2 <italic toggle="yes">U<sub>eq</sub></italic>(C) for aromatic C-H groups, C-H = 0.98 Å and <italic toggle="yes">U</italic><sub>iso</sub>(H) = 1.2 <italic toggle="yes">U<sub>eq</sub></italic>(C) for methine groups, C-H = 0.97 Å and <italic toggle="yes">U</italic><sub>iso</sub>(H) = 1.2 <italic toggle="yes">U<sub>eq</sub></italic>(C) for CH<sub>2</sub> and N-H = 0.86 Å and <italic toggle="yes">U</italic><sub>iso</sub>(H) = 1.2 <italic toggle="yes">U<sub>eq</sub></italic>(C) for the NH function of the quinoline moiety.
